<rules>
Decide who is most likely the impostor and commit to it. Reason only from your memory and the transcript above — assume no roles, kills, or vents you did not witness. Speak your opening as 2-3 short sentences in "free_text", then stop: report what you saw honestly, then either point at ONE living player with a concrete detail or say you are not sure yet.
A witnessed vent is the single strongest fact this game produces — speak it FIRST, at this meeting, even if it happened many ticks ago and even if you already said it at an earlier meeting: a held vent wins the game only once it is on the record. If your memory contains one — a line like "- [tick 12] You witnessed p-3 vent in MEDBAY." — put it on the record as a structured "saw_vent" observation copied from that line exactly: {"type": "saw_vent", "tick": 12, "subject": "p-3", "room": "MEDBAY"}. Only the impostor can vent, so that one row identifies the impostor outright and outweighs every path inference. Speak a "saw_vent" only for a vent your memory says you witnessed — never one you merely heard about or suspect.
Answer the roll-call: state where YOU were with one structured "whereabouts" observation — the room you were in at the tick that matters (the tick it was reported to have happened, or the tick under discussion), copied from your own record. One room, one tick: that single checkable placement is what lets the crew clear you and corner whoever cannot be placed.
The crew catches the impostor by establishing who was WHERE and WHEN, so put the sightings that matter on the record as structured "saw_player" observations (player, room, tick, who else was there) — a player's path is what exposes an impossible alibi later, and placing OTHERS at the tick that matters is testimony only you can give.
Curate, don't dump: pick the 3-5 MOST PROBATIVE observations — always the "found_body" report if you found it, always a witnessed vent, always your own "whereabouts" answer, always the sightings that name your suspect — and leave the rest of your movement log out. Copying dozens of rows buries the signal and rambles past the output cap, which discards your whole turn.
Then either name your single best suspect in ONE "accusation" claim — the chain then passes to whoever you accuse — or, only if nothing you recorded points at anyone, write the word "unsure" in "free_text". To accuse, the "accusation" claim is required: naming a suspect only in "free_text" does not count.
</rules>

<output_format>
Respond with a single JSON object only. No commentary, no markdown, no code fences. It has EXACTLY these 8 top-level keys, every one present and no others ("type" appears only inside each observation/claim item, never on the turn itself):
{"turn_id": "t", "turn_index": 0, "speaker": "p-4", "turn_kind": "opening", "reply_to": null, "observations": [], "claims": [{"type": "accusation", "against": "<one living player id>", "confidence": 0.6, "reason": "<one short phrase>"}], "free_text": "<your 2-3 sentence opening>"}
Fill "observations" with your curated first-hand records, each item one of these shapes:
  {"type": "saw_player", "tick": <int>, "subject": "<player id>", "room": "<room id>", "co_present": ["<player id>", ...]}
  {"type": "completed_task", "tick": <int>, "task_id": "<task id>", "room": "<room id>"}
  {"type": "found_body", "tick": <int>, "body_of": "<player id>", "room": "<room id>"}
  {"type": "saw_vent", "tick": <int>, "subject": "<player id>", "room": "<room id>"} — only for a witnessed vent, copied exactly from your memory line.
  {"type": "whereabouts", "tick": <int>, "room": "<room id>"} — your roll-call answer: the room YOU were in at the tick that matters, copied from your own record (one room, one tick; the speaker is always you, so it names no subject).
Each "claims" item is one of:
  {"type": "alibi", "subject": "p-4", "from_tick": <int>, "to_tick": <int>, "room": "<room id>", "evidence": ["<short ref>", ...]} with from_tick <= to_tick — quote your own memory exactly: ONE room, and only the ticks you actually spent there. If you moved during the window, alibi only the room you were in at the tick that matters — a range that spans rooms you moved between contradicts your own record (your own "completed_task" rows included) and gets you ejected.
  the "accusation" shown in the skeleton above — at most one. Calibrate "confidence" honestly: 1.0 only for a kill or a vent you watched happen first-hand; ~0.7 for a case a second account or a contradiction flag corroborates; ~0.5 for a hunch read off movement alone — almost nothing you infer from paths deserves 1.0.
  {"type": "corroboration", "supports": "<player id>", "on_tick": <int>, "reason": "<one short phrase>"}
Reference only ticks, rooms, players, and tasks that appear above — an invented identifier fails validation. If you are not sure, use "claims": [] and say so in "free_text".
</output_format>
